title: Jupyter Claude
description: Settings for the Jupyter Claude collaboration extension.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Which Claude backend to use. `anthropic` requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. `bedrock` uses the AWS credential chain.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model ID. Plain name for anthropic (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`); cross-region inference profile for bedrock (e.g. `us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8`).

awsRegion.title: AWS region
awsRegion.description: AWS region for the Bedrock backend. Ignored when backend is `anthropic`.

systemPrompt.default: You are a helpful assistant collaborating with a data scientist inside a JupyterLab notebook.
systemPrompt.title: System prompt
systemPrompt.description: System prompt sent to Claude on every conversation.

permissionMode.title: Permission mode
permissionMode.description: How Claude asks for confirmation before using tools. `bypassPermissions` disables all checks (unsafe).
